sentence: This project holds a meeting where scientists share research in engineering, biology, medicine, and computing.
This project builds computer tools that simulate how muscles, tendons, and skeletal structures move together in human motion.
This project builds an AI framework that analyzes video using several kinds of sensory input and explains its decisions clearly.
This project studies how bacteria that generate electrons interact with a microbe that can convert carbon dioxide to methane.
This project tests whether leaves sense the iron status of the entire plant and communicate that information to roots to control iron uptake.
This project studies which genes control how microscopic leaf pores open and close in strawberry plants.
This project studies how RNA molecules used to silence genes in pests affect bacteria in the environment.
This project studies magnetic materials and devices, including magnetic nanoparticles and coils that stimulate the brain.
This project studies how nanoscale organic films make soft metals like tantalum and niobium easier to cut and grind.
This project builds a tool that controls how the plant Catharanthus roseus makes defense-related compounds.
This project holds an annual workshop where researchers share early ideas about programming languages and software verification.
This project studies how to break large quantum computing tasks into smaller pieces and put their solutions back together accurately.
This project studies how the flowers a native solitary bee visits and its time spent foraging affect its offspring numbers.
This project builds a system that uses full-body images to automatically detect and classify suspicious pigmented skin lesions.
This project engineers a bacterium called Agrobacterium to deliver proteins that make plants easier to transform and genome edit.
This project studies how the brains of painted turtles keep working when they get no oxygen.
